title: Former Lions CB charged with kidnappings now a free agent. Could that help him in court?

sources.title: Former Lions CB charged with kidnappings now a free agent. Could that help him in court?
sources.description: Former Detroit Lions cornerback Terrion Arnold cleared waivers at 4 p.m. ET July 6. His next pre-trial hearing is set for July 11.
